---
title: "Citation"
---

If you use LALLPI in your research, please cite the dataset as published on
Harvard Dataverse:

> Cachanosky, Nicolas, João Pedro Bastos, and Alexandre Padilla. 2026.
> "Latin American Left-Leaning Populism Index, V2025.1." Harvard Dataverse.
> https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF.

**DOI:** [10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF](https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF)

## BibTeX

```bibtex
@misc{cachanosky2026lallpi,
  author    = {Cachanosky, Nicolas and Bastos, Jo\~{a}o Pedro and Padilla, Alexandre},
  title     = {Latin American Left-Leaning Populism Index, V2025.1},
  year      = {2026},
  publisher = {Harvard Dataverse},
  doi       = {10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF},
  url       = {https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/KEJ9VF}
}
```

[Download BibTeX file](/lallpi.bib){.btn .btn-primary role="button"}

## Citing the code specifically

If you're referencing the pipeline or website rather than the published
data itself, cite the GitHub repository and release version instead:
[github.com/ncachanosky/LALLPI](https://github.com/ncachanosky/LALLPI).
